The current best lower bound is $(C_1 - o(1))^n \leqslant |A|$ where
$C_1 = 367^{1/5} \approx 3.2578$ [Po20, Section 9.1].
references: [La79] Lovász, László. "On the Shannon capacity of a graph." IEEE Transactions on Information theory 25.1 (1979): 1-7.
[Po20] Polak, Sven. "New methods in coding theory: Error-correcting codes and the Shannon capacity." arXiv preprint arXiv:2005.02945 (2020).
